source_text: Prope est verbum in ore tuo et in corde tuo — hoc est verbum fidei quod praedicamus. Quia si confitearis in ore tuo Dominum Iesum et in corde tuo credideris quod Deus illum suscitavit a mortuis, salvus eris.
pass_a_gloss: Near is the word in your mouth and in your heart — this is the word of faith which we preach. Because if you confess with your mouth the Lord Jesus and believe in your heart that God raised him from the dead, you will be saved.
pass_b_english: [[The word is near you, in your mouth and in your heart >> Bible:Romans 10:8]] — the word of faith we preach. [[If you confess with your mouth that Jesus is Lord and believe in your heart that God raised him from the dead, you will be saved >> Bible:Romans 10:9]].
notes: True OET; no Scheck FOTC Romans.
anf_compare: no ANF for Rufinus Romans; do not copy Scheck FOTC
